name: fishmark
description: Local-first Markdown desktop editor MVP shell.

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on packages/workspace-domain/dist/index.js packages/workspace-application/dist/index.js packages/workspace-infrastructure/dist/index.js dist-electron/main/main.js dist-electron/preload/preload.js dist-electron/shared/app-update.js dist-electron/shared/clipboard-image-import.js dist-electron/shared/document-edit.js dist-electron/shared/document-projection.js dist-electron/shared/editor-test-command.js dist-electron/shared/export-html-file.js dist-electron/shared/external-file-change.js dist-electron/shared/font-families.js dist-electron/shared/menu-command.js dist-electron/shared/open-markdown-file.js dist-electron/shared/preferences.js dist-electron/shared/preload-bridge-mode.js dist-electron/shared/save-markdown-file.js dist-electron/shared/test-run-session.js dist-electron/shared/theme-package.js dist-electron/shared/workspace.js dist-cli/packages/test-harness/src/cli/bin.js http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.dev:electron:test-workbench: wait-on packages/workspace-domain/dist/index.js packages/workspace-application/dist/index.js packages/workspace-infrastructure/dist/index.js dist-electron/main/main.js dist-electron/preload/preload.js dist-electron/shared/app-update.js dist-electron/shared/clipboard-image-import.js dist-electron/shared/document-edit.js dist-electron/shared/document-projection.js dist-electron/shared/editor-test-command.js dist-electron/shared/export-html-file.js dist-electron/shared/external-file-change.js dist-electron/shared/font-families.js dist-electron/shared/menu-command.js dist-electron/shared/open-markdown-file.js dist-electron/shared/preferences.js dist-electron/shared/preload-bridge-mode.js dist-electron/shared/save-markdown-file.js dist-electron/shared/test-run-session.js dist-electron/shared/theme-package.js dist-electron/shared/workspace.js dist-cli/packages/test-harness/src/cli/bin.js http://localhost:5174 && cross-env FISHMARK_START_MODE=test-workbench VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5174 electron .
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && npm run build:cli
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:workspace-application && npm run build:workspace-infrastructure && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/verify-workspace-domain-runtime.mjs && node scripts/verify-workspace-application-runtime.mjs && node scripts/verify-workspace-infrastructure-runtime.mjs
scripts.clean: rimraf dist dist-electron dist-cli packages/workspace-domain/dist packages/workspace-domain/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/workspace-application/dist packages/workspace-application/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/workspace-infrastructure/dist packages/workspace-infrastructure/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.electron.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.renderer.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.vitest.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.cli.tsbuildinfo
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:workspace-application && npm run build:workspace-infrastructure && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.vitest.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.cli.json
scripts.perf:bundle: npm exec vite -- build --sourcemap && node scripts/analyze-renderer-bundle.mjs --dist dist --top 20 --contract fixtures/architecture/editor-foundation-guard.json && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test:editor-foundation: vitest run src/main/editor-foundation-architecture.test.ts packages/editor-core/src/performance src/renderer/performance src/main/analyze-renderer-bundle.test.ts src/main/vite-bundle-provenance.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.perf:baseline: npm run perf:bundle && cross-env FISHMARK_PERF_REPORT=1 npm run test:editor-foundation
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run generate:icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac --dir
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run generate:icons && node scripts/build-win-release.mjs package
scripts.release:mac:beta: npm run build && npm run generate:icons && node scripts/build-mac-release.mjs beta
scripts.release:mac: npm run build && npm run generate:icons && node scripts/build-mac-release.mjs release
scripts.release:win: npm run build && npm run generate:icons && node scripts/build-win-release.mjs release
